::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{sink_rate:.3f} m/s"`]{.hero-value}

**Answer.** A fully optimized 5 mm glider achieves a minimum sink rate of `{python} f"{sink_rate:.3f}"` m/s. This is barely an improvement over the `{python} sink_rate_manual` m/s achieved by the [manually sized 5 mm model with a fuselage](../02-fuselage-model/2026-09-14-01-how-does-modeling-the-fuselage-change-the-optimized-glider.qmd), showing that geometry optimization alone cannot overcome the weight penalty of 5 mm foam.
